PUBLIC COMMENT
Citizens wishing to address the City Council and Successor Agency on any item on the agenda or on any matter
not on the agenda may do so at this time. State law (Government Code Section 54950 et seq.) prohibits the City
Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda .
Upon request, the City Council may, in their discretion, allow citizen participation on a specific item on the agenda
at the time the item is considered by the City Council. If you wish to address the City Council /Successor Agency
at this time, please complete a speaker's card and give it to the City Clerk prior to commencement of the City
Council meeting. Please limit your remarks to three (3) minutes.

To increase the effectiveness of the Public Comment Period, the following rules shall be followed: No person shall
make any remarks which result in disrupting, disturbing or otherwise impeding the meeting.

Members of the public may participate by submitting their comments written comments through email at
cityclerk@ci.commerce.ca.us.

AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
5:00 P.M. Council Meeting
Location: Main Entrance of the City Hall

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Rebollo called meeting to order at 5:17 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT Liliana Magana, MUSD Board Member, thanked outgoing Councilmembers Mendoza and Soria and congratulated newly elected Councilmembers Lainez and Garcia.



SCHEDULED MATTERS

1.. Recognition of Outgoing Councilmembers Due to non-attendance of outgoing Councilmember Soria and Mendoza this item was not discussed.  

ADJOURNMENT Meeting adjourned at 5:49 p.m.

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and via the City's website.


Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.

To protect public health, this meeting is being held in accordance with AB 361, Government Code section 54954(e)(1) (A). Given the proclaimed state of emergency and the Los Angeles County Health Department recommendation for social distancing for public meetings, which is also consistent with Cal OSHA requirements for social distancing, the City will be conducting public meeting at the Entrance of the City Hall and via video/teleconferencing.   

1.	Watch or Listen: Meetings are broadcast/streamed live on the City of Commerce’s Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/City-of-Commerce-123903054365151/?ref. Archived, on-demand video of each meeting is maintained on the City’s Facebook as part of the public record.

2.	You can leave comment at the meeting location or submit Comments before the Meeting: Members of the public can provide public comment by sending an e-mail to cityclerk@ci.commerce.ca.us for City Council meetings, and the comment will be read during Public Comment portion.  

3.	At the time and date of the meeting, please click this URL to join the Zoom meeting: 

https://us06web.zoom.us/j/81075857307?pwd=eldOUGhRbkFXWHRGakQvUHYxWHhLUT09

Passcode: 913520 or join by phone: Dial 1(720) 707-2699; Meeting ID: 810 7585 7307

3.. Councilmember Comments/Reports Councilmembers Lainez, Garcia, and Altamirano thanked their supporters, volunteers, election teams, and community and family members for all their support and the fantastic job during the election campaigning. 

Vice Mayor Argumedo and Mayor Rebollo congratulated all Councilmember-elect for excellent campaigning and said they look forward to working with all of them as a team. 

2.. Oath of Office for Newly Elected Councilmembers and Assumption of Offices Roman Lainez performed the swearing-in ceremony for Councilmember-elect Lainez.

Susie Altamirano performed the swearing-in ceremony for Councilmember Elect Altamirano.

Director of Administrative Services and City Clerk Shumway performed the swearing-in ceremony for Councilmember-elect Garcia.

All three Councilmembers assumed the office and were seated.
